title: 循环网络与时间反向传播
task: binary delayed first-sign recall, synthetic independent sequences
state_policy: zero reset before every independent sequence and every epoch; no cross-batch carry
checkpoint_policy: fixed final step 320, no best-seed or validation selection
evaluation: all seeds, all conditions, validation and once final test; per-run BCE and accuracy; 3-seed descriptive mean and sample SD, not population CI
gradient_probe: initial and final gradient of one final logit with respect to each input timestep; full graph, separately record training-graph gradient with detach
negative_results: retain every run; no hyperparameter tuning based on validation or test; identical initialization and data paired across conditions
interpretation_limit: mechanistic toy evidence only, no natural-language or real-world generalization claim
